evidence_class_boundaries.current_implementation: Requires exact source at the frozen upper revision; T2 baseline locators are candidates only.
evidence_class_boundaries.historical_implementation: Requires exact bytes at a reachable ancestor plus chronology evidence; a deleted locator alone is insufficient.
evidence_class_boundaries.active_specification: Can establish a requirement at its cited revision only and never implementation.
evidence_class_boundaries.catalog_prose: Can establish exact wording and identity presence only and never mechanics, states, routes, assets, responsiveness, or implementation.
evidence_class_boundaries.cancelled_design: Requires cited design plus cancellation disposition and never establishes implementation or shipment.
evidence_class_boundaries.unknown: Preserves unresolved absence or conflict and cannot be replaced by analogy.
